title: Validate input videos before segmentation
user_visible_behavior: CLI and GUI runs reject missing, unreadable, or unsupported video inputs with a clear error before starting expensive pose extraction.
evidence_plan: CLI preflights inputs via validate_video before pose extraction and exits with a clear error.
GUI upload rejects non-video and missing-field requests with 4xx JSON errors.
Unit + e2e coverage for corrupt, unsupported, too-short, and missing inputs.
evidence: 2026-07-04: src/runtime/video_validation.py validates by content (PyAV probe), not extension; cli.main.run_pipeline preflights via validate_video (min duration vs seq_len/fps) and returns exit 1 with a clear message; GUI /api/upload-and-start rejects non-video and missing-field uploads. Tests green in CI run 28692435270 (all 6 jobs, 3 OSes): tests/test_video_validation.py, tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_upload_rejects_non_video, ::test_upload_rejects_missing_field, tests/test_cli_pipeline_smoke.py short-video rejection.

title: Split core contracts, analysis engine, API services, and playback contracts
user_visible_behavior: CLI, desktop, browser GUI, and future clients can share one runtime/API contract while preserving current CLI and GUI behavior.
evidence_plan: Branch refactor/runtime-api-engine is based on shipped feat/first-release and main remains untouched until parity is proven.
rallyclip_core imports stay lightweight and own contracts, intervals, pipeline selection, and pure playback scheduling.
rallyclip_engine owns model-object analysis execution from preprocessing through CSV-ready intervals.
rallyclip_api provides a service facade used by Flask routes.
Current CLI smoke/config, GUI smoke/e2e, startup import, native playback, and video-validation tests pass.
evidence: 2026-07-04: COMPLETE and merged to main. rallyclip_core (contracts, intervals, pipeline resolution, SavedMatchStore, playback scheduling), rallyclip_engine (AnalysisModel preprocess/infer/postprocess, manifest-driven pipeline selection), rallyclip_api (RallyClipServices facade + JSON serialization). CLI and Flask GUI are both thin facade clients; CLI gained --json. Golden CLI parity on committed fixture (byte-exact same-machine; 0.25s cross-platform bar). Landed via PR #24 (fcda361) and PR #25 (ed39983); main == feat/first-release. CI matrix (3 OS x test/e2e) fully green for the first time in repo history (run 28692435270). Also fixed en route: issue #21 A/V sync drift (336ms -> 0.3ms, per-interval seek + sample-granular audio reconciliation), jobs_lock status/cancel race caught by the new concurrency hammer test, PyAV consolidated as the only runtime video decoder.
notes: Done. Follow-on tracked separately: onnx-pose-runner-swap, frozen-app e2e tiers, CI dependency lockfile, gui.app config-object injection (retire module-global monkeypatching).

title: Keep CLI config behavior stable
user_visible_behavior: Users can run RallyClip with a TOML config file or explicit CLI flags and get consistent output paths, CSV options, and inference settings.
evidence_plan: Contract fields (fps/seq_len/imgsz/conf/feature_set/screen size/yolo_model) resolve manifest-first; config.toml cannot silently override them.
Mutable postprocess + IO resolve CLI -> config.toml -> manifest.
README-documented flags parse; --json emits the stable RunResult payload.
evidence: 2026-07-04: tests/test_cli_config_contract.py (11 tests) pins resolution order and the config-sets-contract-field warning path; tests/test_cli_json_output.py pins the --json payload; golden parity test runs the real CLI end-to-end. All green in CI run 28692435270 on 3 OSes.

title: Preserve desktop and browser GUI processing flow
user_visible_behavior: Users can select a video, start segmentation, view progress, and receive completion or error status from the local GUI without losing device or output settings.
evidence_plan: Import regression: gui.app startup does not load torch, ultralytics, av, or numpy.
Backend defaults/runtime endpoints stay responsive without device probing on library startup.
Upload processing runs in an analysis worker subprocess and reports progress through the existing API.
Manual app launch confirms replay library opens quickly and New Match warmup does not bring inference memory into the parent process.
evidence: 2026-06-28: PYTHONPATH=src import probe showed gui.app imports in 0.216s with torch/ultralytics/av/numpy all unloaded. Tests passed: tests/test_gui_startup_imports.py; tests/test_gui_smoke.py::test_gui_health_and_defaults; tests/test_gui_smoke.py::test_gui_pipeline_streams_features_into_inference; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_config_defaults_contract; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_upload_rejects_non_video; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_upload_rejects_missing_field; tests/test_gui_e2e.py::test_default_job_completes. 2026-06-30: packaged Mac release on feat/first-release was built, Developer ID signed with hardened runtime, notarized by Apple, stapled, mounted, and Gatekeeper accepted the app from the DMG. User manually verified source-only native replay completed without the proxy freeze, packaged app launch worked, welcome persistence worked, and inference/replay smoke flow was acceptable for v0.1.0. 2026-06-30 update: downloaded/installed notarized DMG showed a blank QtWebEngine window; diagnostic launch showed V8 CodeRange OOM from missing hardened-runtime JIT entitlements. Fixed local dist app and fixed DMG now carry QtWebEngine/V8 entitlements and render, but the fixed DMG is pending Apple notarization/stapling before publication. 2026-06-30 final: entitlement-fixed DMG was Apple-accepted, stapled, uploaded to GitHub Releases, downloaded from GitHub, installed, and opened successfully.
notes: Release startup blocker mitigated and v0.1.0 desktop flow is release-ready. Replay/library startup no longer imports analysis/transcode stack, /api/config/defaults is static, New Match warmup runs in a child process, and upload jobs run in an analysis worker subprocess so Torch/YOLO memory exits after completion/cancel. Production Mac replay uses native source playback; automatic proxy/HLS playback is not part of v0.1.0. Remaining separate tracked work: runtime-video-validation, ONNX/Ultralytics replacement, bundle slimming, CI/CD, and shared runtime/API restructuring. Entitlement-fixed GitHub release DMG was downloaded, installed, and opened successfully; the previous notarized DMG must not ship.

title: Stabilize rally interval decoding
user_visible_behavior: Frame probabilities decode into tennis rally intervals with stable thresholds, minimum duration handling, and CSV/video output timing.
evidence_plan: Gaussian + hysteresis decode with min-duration handling produces stable intervals on the golden fixture.
Exported segment video stays lip-synced across many cuts.
evidence: 2026-07-04: golden CLI parity locks decode output on the committed fixture (byte-exact same-machine; 0.25s cross-platform tolerance = one 0.2s hysteresis hop, the measured torch-version noise floor). Issue #21 fixed: segment_video rewritten to per-interval seek+decode with sample-granular audio reconciliation; measured drift 336ms -> 0.3ms over 10 segments (tests/test_segment_av_sync.py). tests/test_segment.py + av-sync suite green in CI run 28692435270.

title: Track training and evaluation quality
user_visible_behavior: Training changes report repeatable frame and segment metrics so model quality regressions are visible before release.

title: Use standard macOS app storage locations
user_visible_behavior: Packaged Mac installs store saved matches, preferences, logs, caches, and scratch files in standard macOS locations instead of a top-level ~/RallyClip folder, while existing ~/RallyClip data migrates without data loss.
evidence_plan: Packaged app resolves saved match data under ~/Library/Application Support/RallyClip.
Preview/cache/job scratch data resolves under ~/Library/Caches/RallyClip where appropriate.
Logs resolve under ~/Library/Logs/RallyClip.
One-time migration preserves existing ~/RallyClip/library matches, preferences, and outputs.
Tests or manual migration evidence prove old installs still open existing saved matches.
notes: Current v0.1.0 packaged app stores data under ~/RallyClip. This worked for first release but is not the normal macOS app-storage convention; migrate in a future release with a clear fallback/backup strategy.

title: Replace Ultralytics/torch pose inference with a torch-free ONNX runner
user_visible_behavior: Analysis produces identical segments without importing torch or ultralytics at runtime, cutting inference memory (~530MB -> ~155MB class) and enabling opencv-python removal.
evidence_plan: Preprocessing bitwise-equal to Ultralytics rect letterbox at the production contract (imgsz=960, dynamic-axes export).
Decoded contract parity (boxes/conf/keypoints, iou=0.7 NMS, max_det=300, conf-sorted) on a wide frame set.
Full-pipeline segment parity vs torch on the golden clip and 60s samples from all 11 raw match videos.
Memory/perf benchmark at 960; then integrate runner into RallyClip src and demote torch/ultralytics to a dev extra.
evidence: 2026-07-04: yolo_onnx_runner (YOLO-ONNX repo, python/yolo_onnx_runner.py) validated: letterbox bitwise-equal to Ultralytics; decoded outputs on 40-frame set IoU >= 0.999997, kpt err <= 3.1e-4 px, count+order match 1.000; stage-3 golden clip e2e via RuntimeDeps injection produced a BYTE-EQUAL segments CSV vs the torch path. 11-video 60s-sample sweep running. Plan + results: RallyClip-perf/docs/onnx-pose-parity-plan.md.
notes: Model export must be at imgsz=960 with dynamic axes (rect letterbox 960x544 for 16:9); Ultralytics NMS defaults iou=0.7/max_det=300. YOLO26 e2e export (NMS in graph) is the strategic alternative.
